entry.title: PotentialGrit 1.0.1
entry.summary: **PotentialGrit 1.0.1** - Much lighter on the MPC's CPU: DUST's compressor and wobble, FILTER and RING now do their heavy maths every few samples instead of every sample, and the saturation uses a fast curve. Version 1.0.0 measured 13% on an MPC One; this should be a fraction of that. Re-run TEST in MPC TOOLS to see.

entry.title: PotentialGrit 1.0.0
entry.summary: ## PotentialGrit 1.0.0 The first release: **seven lo-fi effects in one box**. - **DUST:** glue compression, hiss and crackle that follow the music, and wobble - **CRUSH:** bits, sample rate and tone - **FILTER:** low, band or high pass, with resonance and drive - **KILL:** a three-band DJ kill EQ - **ECHO:** a dark tape echo locked to your tempo - **CHOP:** a tempo gate on the song position, with left/right bounce - **RING:** ring mod with a sweep Each effect keeps its own settings, and switchin
